clips.title: The story
paras: Tharil'zun's Head reaches Lakeshire as proof that the commander terrorizing the Redridge approaches is dead. He led the Blackrock Outrunners occupying Stonewatch.

Blackrock orcs at Stonewatch Keep have pressed Lakeshire hard, raiding farms and ambushing travelers on the roads. Tharil'zun directed the Blackrock Outrunners at the head of these attacks. Lakeshire's garrison cannot risk acting on rumors or partial victories, so Marshal Marris demands proof that Tharil'zun is dead. His severed head shows that the Outrunners' coordinated ambushes from the keep have suffered a major blow.
